bibliographic.title: Just Listen Up, Kid!
bibliographic.author: Andrew Schultz
bibliographic.description:
This was written for Single Choice Jam. You'll probably guess the gimmick pretty quickly. There is a happy ending.
I wrote structures that would help flesh out the dialogue, but I hit time constraints writing the main stuff. There are ten pages where Stuff Happens.
This is not as puzzle-heavy as my other works, but I had the idea when the jam started and I'm slipping it in now just under the wire. So it's undergone a lot of mental probing. I hope you find it amusing.
